integrity: The all-parameter count and small-coupling stability statements follow from the explicit proof. Finite symbolic/numerical checks are supplementary. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The complete count is established only for a=1, b>0 and 0<k<1/3; beyond this window the amplitude equation is not proved monotone. Linear two-cycle sink–repeller splitting is established for sufficiently small k>0 at b=1 and nearby parameters, not throughout the wedge. No global attractor census or high-gain classification is asserted. Historical priority may be incomplete.
title: Exact weak-coupling period-two census and sink–repeller splitting in a memristive Lozi map
